_about: Retrofit kit parts and the implement used in the sim. Real products with published specs. Values marked ASSUMPTION are not published and must be measured on the real machine.

implement.name: Kverneland Optima V, 6 rows
implement.why: JBJ is a Kverneland dealer; maize is planted in 75 cm rows
implement.source: Kverneland: Optima V seeds maize with 6 rows at 75 or 80 cm (Kverneland range brochure / press release); transport width 3 m (dealer listing)
implement.working_speed_note: ASSUMPTION: normal precision-planting speed. Tune per seed and soil

steering.name: Sveaverken F200 auto steer (electric steering-wheel motor)
steering.source: sveaverken.com/f200-auto-steer-system (angle-sensor figures from the F200 Max page)
steering.motor: electric steering wheel 380 mm, 12/24 V, max torque 15/20 Nm, IP65; works 0.1-26 km/h, slopes up to 20 deg
steering.angle_sensor: 5 V, up to 200 Hz, resolution < 0.1 deg, IP67 (F200 Max figures)
steering.receiver: GNSS receiver 162 x 67 mm, GPS L1/L2, GLONASS L1/L2, BDS B1I/B2I, Galileo E1/E5b, IP67, 2.5 cm
steering.front_wheel_rate_note: ASSUMPTION: front-wheel steering rate through the motor + hydrostatic steering. Measure lock-to-lock time on JBJ's tractor
steering.steer_response_note: ASSUMPTION: first-order lag of motor + hydraulics

gnss.rate_note: u-blox ZED-F9P class receivers run RTK at up to 20 Hz; 10 Hz is the usual autosteer rate
gnss.rtk_fixed_note: u-blox ZED-F9P datasheet: RTK 0.01 m + 1 ppm CEP
gnss.single_note: u-blox ZED-F9P: 1.5 m CEP without corrections
gnss.heading_note: ArduSimple dual-antenna kits: ~0.14 deg at 1 m antenna separation
gnss.hold_note: Sveaverken F200 SE keeps cm accuracy 10 min after losing corrections (PRO: 20 min). The sim ignores this hold on purpose so the RTK-loss stop can be tested

lidar.name: Livox Mid-360
lidar.mount: front of the tractor, upside down at 1.3 m, so the -7..52 deg field of view looks down at the ground ahead (-52..7 deg)
lidar.price_note: Livox list price, Oct 2026 (Mid-360L about EUR 739)

safety.remote_timeout_note: ASSUMPTION: stop if the handheld remote's signal is missing for 0.5 s (passive stop)
safety.brake_decel_note: ASSUMPTION: conservative stopping deceleration of a tractor on loose soil. Measure on JBJ's tractor
safety.reaction_note: ASSUMPTION: sensor frame + processing + actuator delay

remote_estop.name: Industrial wireless e-stop (FORT Wireless E-Stop: up to 1 km line of sight; or Tele Radio)
